title: Weather at Gale (REMS)

values.label: Surface pressure (annual range)
values.note: Seasonal CO₂ cycle and diurnal thermal tides at Gale Crater (Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014; Haberle et al. 2014).

values.label: Air temperature (sols 1–100 range, 1.6 m boom)
values.note: 190 K nighttime low to 270 K daytime high during sols 1–100 (Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014); multi-year Gale range 180–278 K / −93 to +5 °C (Martínez et al. 2017).

values.label: Ground brightness temperature (multi-year range)
values.note: 173 K pre-dawn minimum to 289 K midday maximum across Gale seasons (Martínez et al. 2017; up to ~280 K / +7 °C in sols 1–100, Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014).

limits.label: Armstrong limit (human physiological threshold)
limits.source: Water boils at human body temperature (37 °C) below ~6.3 kPa; Gale pressure (700–920 Pa, above water's 611.65 Pa triple point) is ~7–9× below the Armstrong limit, requiring a full pressure suit (NASA-STD-3001 Vol 1)

limits.label: Walk-scale spatial weather map
limits.source: REMS is a single rover-local weather station on Curiosity's mast; no walk-scale spatial weather map exists

note: REMS is a rover-local meteorological station on Curiosity; no walk-scale spatial weather map or operational forecast exists for Gale Crater. Values represent observed Gale climatology.
claim_boundary: Context card only — never interpolated into per-cell route weather maps. Excursion thermal/dust windows derived from climatology are Scenario assumptions.
source: Gómez-Elvira et al. 2012, Space Sci Rev 170:583, doi:10.1007/s11214-012-9921-1; Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014, JGR-Planets 119:1680, doi:10.1002/2013JE004576; Haberle et al. 2014, JGR-Planets 119:1544, doi:10.1002/2013JE004488; Martínez et al. 2017, Space Sci Rev 212:295, doi:10.1007/s11214-017-0360-x; NASA PDS Atmospheres Node urn:nasa:pds:msl_rems_bundle
date_range: 2012-08 → 2012-11 (sols 1–100 baseline, Gómez-Elvira et al. 2014); 2012-08 → 2017 (multi-year review, Martínez et al. 2017)
